# desk_payments

Desk payments records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="desk_payments", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="desk_payments", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | Top-level filter | Account id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `allocations` | object | Object value; see collection filter rules | Map identifying sources/targets and assigned amounts; the containing collection determines the key type. joint_fundings keys are joint_sources IDs. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Amount in integer minor currency units. Whether it denotes an instruction, liability or posted movement depends on this record type. |
| `business_area` | string | Top-level filter | Business area: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `currency` | string | Top-level filter | Currency code for the associated monetary fields. Preserve separate currency balances. Public values represented here: `EUR`, `GBP`, `USD`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `executor_id` | string | Top-level filter | Executor id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `fee_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Charge for this object/operation in minor units; use the applicable product terms for when it is incurred. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `instruction_id` | string | Top-level filter | Instruction id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `kind` | string | Top-level filter | Record or service type. Fields and meanings can differ between kinds. Public values represented here: `CURRENCY`, `PURPOSE`, `TREASURY`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `mandate_id` | string | Top-level filter | Mandate id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `mandate_version` | integer | Top-level filter | Mandate version: version of the named evidence/object. Check applicability and status along with its version. |
| `minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Logical event or posting minute measured from the session clock, not wall-clock runtime. |
| `obligation_id` | string | Top-level filter | Obligation id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `SETTLED`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
